defects.claim: The issue asks for the client-side bucketing to be stated in the PR body, and the PR body never says so. It is only in the docblock at DashboardActivityChart.vue:7-11.
defects.evidence: PR Body has no mention of it.

defects.claim: 30 bars at 9.67px with 8px gaps need about 522px. The container uses `overflow-hidden` with no wrap or scroll, so a narrow panel clips the oldest bars silently.
defects.evidence: `flex items-end gap-2 overflow-hidden`, with `shrink-0` on every bar.

defects.claim: The highlight colour deviates from the issue. `dashboardShippedColors.ts` was meant to supply the warm accent but holds no warm colour, so the diff uses the `needs-you` token (`--color-needs-you` at src/design-system/theme.css:27). The deviation is documented in the docblock.

not_verified: Server-side limits on `GET /api/v1/board/activity` (row cap or time window): the console backend is not in this checkout. If it returns only the latest N rows, the 30D view could be undercounted.

Dashboard integration: no test covers `DashboardView` mounting `DashboardActivityChart` or calling `listBoardActivity`. The truncated test log does not show whether the existing DashboardView spec exercises it.
